contacts.notes: President and COO of Goldman Sachs. Has been with the firm since 1994. Named President when Solomon became CEO in 2018.

contacts.title: Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: Chairman, President and CEO of Bank of America since 2010. Led Bank of America transformation and recovery post-financial crisis.

contacts.title: Chief Financial Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Financial Officer of Bank of America. Joined from CIBC where he was Group Head of Capital Markets. Named CFO in 2021.

contacts.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: President and CEO of Wells Fargo since October 2019. Previously CEO of BNY Mellon and Visa. Leading Wells Fargo transformation following its retail banking scandal.

contacts.title: Chief Financial Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Financial Officer of Wells Fargo. Joined in 2020 from BNY Mellon where he also served as CFO.

contacts.title: Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Executive Officer of Citigroup since February 2021. First woman to lead a major US bank. Leading multi-year transformation of Citi global operations.

contacts.title: Chief Financial Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Financial Officer of Citigroup. Has been with Citi since 2001. Named CFO in 2019.

contacts.title: Executive Chairman
contacts.notes: Executive Chairman of Morgan Stanley. CEO 2010-January 2024. Led Morgan Stanley transformation into leading wealth and asset management firm. Oversaw E*Trade ($13B) and Eaton Vance ($7B) acquisitions.

contacts.title: Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Executive Officer of Morgan Stanley since January 2024. Previously Co-President and head of Institutional Securities. Has been with Morgan Stanley since 1990.

contacts.title: Group Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: Group CEO of UBS since April 2023. Returned to lead Credit Suisse integration. Previously Group CEO 2011-2020.

contacts.title: Group Chief Financial Officer
contacts.notes: Group CFO of UBS since 2023. Has been with UBS since 2007. Overseeing financial integration of Credit Suisse.

contacts.title: Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Executive Officer of Deutsche Bank since April 2018. Has been with Deutsche Bank since 1989. Led major restructuring refocusing on corporate banking and wealth management.

contacts.title: Chief Financial Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Financial Officer of Deutsche Bank since 2017. Previously EVP and CFO of Citigroup Institutional Clients Group.

contacts.title: Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: CEO of Lazard since 2023. Previously Vice Chairman at Lazard. Former Director of the Office of Management and Budget under President Obama.

contacts.title: Chief Financial Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Financial Officer of Lazard. Long-tenured Lazard executive. Oversees financial reporting and treasury for the global firm.

contacts.title: Co-Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: Co-Executive Chairman and CEO of Evercore. Previously Senior Chairman at Goldman Sachs. Joined Evercore in 2016. Grandson of Goldman Sachs Sidney Weinberg.

contacts.title: Co-Executive Chairman (Retired 2022)
contacts.notes: Co-Executive Chairman Emeritus of Evercore. Served as CEO 2009-2022. Previously co-founded BlackRock in 1988. Built Evercore into a top-ranked independent advisory firm.

contacts.title: Co-Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder
contacts.notes: Co-CEO and Co-Founder of Sun Capital Partners. Co-founded 1995 with Rodger Krouse. Previously at Lehman Brothers. Overseen over 400 acquisitions with operational improvement focus.

contacts.title: Co-Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder
contacts.notes: Co-CEO and Co-Founder of Sun Capital Partners. Co-founded 1995 with Marc Leder. Previously at Lehman Brothers. Leads deal sourcing and portfolio operations.

contacts.title: Founder and Managing Partner
contacts.notes: Founder and Managing Partner of Marlin Equity Partners. Founded 2005. Previously at DLJ Merchant Banking Partners and Bear Stearns. Built Marlin into a leading technology PE firm with over 200 acquisitions.

contacts.title: Managing Partner
contacts.notes: Managing Partner at Marlin Equity Partners. Focuses on technology and software acquisitions globally.

contacts.title: Managing Partner
contacts.notes: Managing Partner of Frontenac Company. Leads Chief Executive Connections (CXC) model for sourcing and building lower middle market businesses.

contacts.title: Partner
contacts.notes: Partner at Frontenac Company. Focuses on business services and consumer investments in the lower middle market.

contacts.title: Managing Partner
contacts.notes: Managing Partner and Co-Founder of Huron Capital Partners. Founded 1999. Leads Huron thesis-driven approach to building platform companies through acquisition.

contacts.title: Partner
contacts.notes: Partner at Huron Capital Partners. Focuses on deal origination and portfolio company development across business services and healthcare.

contacts.title: Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: CEO of CalPERS since 2016. Previously Director of the Washington State Department of Retirement Systems. Leads $503B fund serving approximately 2 million California public employees.

contacts.title: Board Chair
contacts.notes: Board Chair of the CalPERS Board of Administration. Elected member representing state employees. Also a member of the California State Personnel Board.

contacts.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: President and CEO of Ontario Teachers Pension Plan since 2020. Previously Head of International at Ontario Teachers. Leads global investment strategy from Toronto for CAD $247.5B fund.

contacts.title: Chief Investment Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Investment Officer of Ontario Teachers Pension Plan. Has been with the fund since 1999. Named CIO in 2019.

contacts.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: President and CEO of CPP Investments since 2021. Leads investment of the Canada Pension Plan Fund (CAD $632B) for 21 million Canadians.

contacts.title: Chief Investment Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Investment Officer of CPP Investments. Has been with the fund since 2007.

contacts.title: Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: CEO of Hamilton Lane. Has been with the firm since 1995. Led Hamilton Lane IPO on NASDAQ in 2017 (HLNE).

contacts.title: Vice Chairman
contacts.notes: Vice Chairman of Hamilton Lane. Has been with the firm since 1999. Previously Chief Investment Officer. Named Vice Chairman in 2019.

contacts.title: Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: CEO of StepStone Group since 2021. Co-founded in 2007. Instrumental in StepStone NASDAQ IPO (STEP) in 2020.

contacts.title: Managing Partner, President and Chief Operating Officer
contacts.notes: Managing Partner, President and COO of StepStone Group. Co-founded 2007. Oversees operations, legal, and compliance. Previously at Credit Suisse Private Equity.

contacts.title: Senior Managing Director and Co-Founder
contacts.notes: Senior Managing Director and Co-Founder of HarbourVest Partners. Co-founded in 1982. Pioneered the private equity fund of funds model.

contacts.title: Managing Director
contacts.notes: Managing Director at HarbourVest Partners. Focuses on US primary fund investments and secondary transactions. Over two decades with HarbourVest.

contacts.title: Founder and Partner
contacts.notes: Founder and Partner of First Round Capital. Founded Half.com (sold to eBay $350M, 2000). Founded First Round Capital in 2004. Early investor in Uber, Square, Warby Parker, and Mint.

contacts.title: Partner
contacts.notes: Partner at First Round Capital. Previously a founder and operator. Focuses on enterprise software, developer tools, and infrastructure investments.

contacts.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: President and CEO of Y Combinator since 2023. Previously co-founded Initialized Capital. YC alum (2007) and early investor in Coinbase, Instacart, and Cruise.

contacts.title: Partner
contacts.notes: Partner at Y Combinator. Founded Monzo Bank in 2015, one of Europe most successful neobanks. Co-founder of GoCardless (YC W11). Joined YC as partner in 2021.

contacts.title: Co-Founder and Managing Partner
contacts.notes: Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Lux Capital since 2000. Focuses on deep tech including defense, robotics, genomics, and AI.

contacts.title: Co-Founder and Managing Partner
contacts.notes: Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Lux Capital since 2000. Focuses on energy, materials science, and life sciences. Previously at Battery Ventures.

contacts.title: Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Executive Officer of GIC Private Limited since 2017. Has been with GIC since 1993. Oversees Singapore foreign reserve investment in over 40 countries.

contacts.title: Group President and Chief Investment Officer
contacts.notes: Group President and CIO of GIC. Has been with GIC since 1997. Leads investment management of $770B+ portfolio.

contacts.title: Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Executive Officer of Temasek Holdings since 2021. Leads global investment strategy for SGD $389B portfolio.

contacts.title: Chief Investment Officer
contacts.notes: Chief Investment Officer of Temasek Holdings. Has been with Temasek since 2007. Oversees portfolio management of SGD $389B portfolio.

contacts.title: Managing Director and Group Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: Managing Director and Group CEO of Mubadala Investment Company since 2002. Also Chairman of the Executive Affairs Authority of Abu Dhabi. Leads $302B investment platform.

contacts.title: Deputy Group Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: Deputy Group CEO of Mubadala Investment Company. Oversees technology, venture, and international investments.

contacts.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
contacts.notes: President and CEO of U.S. Bancorp since April 15, 2025 (effective at the conclusion of the Annual Meeting of Shareholders). Previously served as President. Succeeded Andy Cecere who became Executive Chairman.

contacts.title: Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
contacts.notes: Senior Executive Vice President and CFO of U.S. Bancorp. Has served as Senior EVP since April 2023 and as CFO since September 2023. Has been with U.S. Bank since 2000. (Source: 2024 10-K, p. 133)

contacts.title: Founder
contacts.notes: Founder of SV Angel. Angel investor since 1992. (Source: svangel.com)

contacts.title: Managing Partner
contacts.notes: Managing Partner of Lerer Hippeau since the firm's founding in 2010. (Source: lererhippeau.com/team)

contacts.title: Managing Partner
contacts.notes: Managing Partner of Lerer Hippeau since the firm's founding in 2010. (Source: lererhippeau.com/team)
